title: Inline lookup editor: picker trigger shows placeholder instead of the selected record's name
body:
## Summary

When editing a `lookup` / `master_detail` / `user` / `owner` field **inline in the data grid** (the inline editors wired in #2122), the `LookupField` picker **trigger button shows the placeholder "选择… / Select…" instead of the currently-selected record's name**.

## Severity — display only (value is correct)

The data is never wrong: the field persists the correct record **id**, and the **read-mode cell** (`LookupCellRenderer`) resolves and shows the record name normally. Only the inline **editor trigger** fails to display the current / just-picked record's name.

Verified end-to-end that the value flow is fine: on the showcase field-zoo, changing "Lookup → Account" to a different account persisted as the right id (`f_lookup = 'Z63yUmXdfFpEWJwO'` = Contoso), and reverted cleanly.

## Repro (dev build on latest objectui `main`, e.g. the `:5417` Studio dev console)

1. Studio → **Data** pillar → an object with a lookup field — e.g. the showcase `字段动物园` (`showcase_field_zoo`), column **"Lookup → Account"**.
2. Click the lookup cell to edit → the trigger shows **"选择…"** even though the field already has a value (e.g. *Northwind*).
3. Open the picker, choose a **different** record (e.g. *Contoso*) → the editor stages/closes, but the cell shows **"选择…"** until a page reload. After reload the read cell correctly shows the record name.

Confirmed it is **not** async-loading latency: the trigger stays "选择…" at 300 ms / 1 s / **2.5 s**.

## Root-cause analysis (narrowed)

`LookupField` resolves the selected value's display via `findOption(value)` over `staticOptions` / `fetchedOptions` / `pickerResolvedRecords` (`LookupField.tsx` ~509-522), plus a hydration `useEffect` (~464-506) that fetches the referenced record by id into `pickerResolvedRecords` when no option resolves it.

- The picker itself works (fetches the related records), so `hasDataSource` + `referenceTo` (the field has `reference: showcase_account`) are available in the inline context.
- So the failure is in that **hydration / match path in the grid-cell context** — either the per-id fetch (`dataSource.findOne` / `find({ $filter: { [idField]: id } })`, ~478-489) doesn't resolve, or `findOption(value)` doesn't match the fetched option's `value` (an `idField` / value-shape mismatch). `recordToOption` computes `value = record[idField] ?? record.id ?? record._id` (~93); the lookup field defines no explicit `idField`/`displayField`.
- The **read** path uses a different component (`LookupCellRenderer`) which resolves fine — that's why only the editor is affected.

## Suggested next step

A focused debug session: instrument `LookupField`'s `hasDataSource`, `referenceTo`, `idField`, the hydration fetch result, and `findOption(value)` in the grid-cell context to see whether the fetch returns nothing or the matching fails, then align the editor's resolution with the read renderer's.

## Related

- #2122 — wired relational fields (lookup/master_detail/user/owner) into the inline editor (this is where the issue surfaced).
- #2124 — structured-value types inline.
- #2121 — read-only/computed gating.
